method: Country-specific piecewise annual histories grounded in federation history and temporally gated current competition/development structures.
evidence_rules: Brazil's 1950 state-federation context and 1955 CBT foundation anchor institutional history; current affiliation, junior-regulation and coach-registry evidence is not backcast.
Chile's 1880s/1890s tennis roots, 1920 federation and 1927 ITF affiliation anchor tradition; JTI and junior-circuit reforms are gated to 2025/2026.
Programme capacity, affiliations and tournament structures are distinct from participation and player outcomes.
Competition quality is based on organised opportunity/system depth rather than direct conversion of elite-player success.
Historical interpolation remains lower-confidence where no contemporaneous national structural observation is available.
No held-out validation ranking is used for tuning.
